scope: Synthetic native PDF handwriting attachments, Chromium pen/mouse and deterministic recognition; excludes real model quality and physical Pencil/Sidecar

checks.id: legacy attachment editor preserves pen input on an existing note
stroke eraser undo and redo retain original paths
save preserves native attachment first then automatically stores distinct recognition text
manual correction saves without another model call or replacing original strokes
host draft restores unsaved mouse-fallback strokes after reload
lost save acknowledgement locks draft and exact retry creates no duplicate attachment
recognition failure preserves saved handwriting and corrected text
explicit recognition retry recovers after a definite model failure
parent handoff restores final strokes when host draft write never reached storage
library shortcut cannot bypass the open handwriting editor
external Unicode annotation identities retain working draft and PDF saves
miniature board remains usable at narrow width and in dark theme
inline PDF handwriting exit automatically recognizes linked strokes without opening a board
unsaved linked transcription correction survives annotation refresh
lost correction acknowledgement retries exact text without another model call or changing legacy strokes
definite transcript version conflict preserves editable text and explicit rebase saves against current strokes
in-flight correction remains locked across card rerender and cannot discard a newer draft
original unchanged with no browser errors or external requests
